fields.summary_ko.0: Truist raised Walmart (WMT)'s price target from $114 to $134 (6% upside) while maintaining a Buy rating, citing premium valuation of advertising, marketplace, and membership businesses.
fields.summary_ko.1: WMT raised its 2027 net revenue growth rate from 4–5% to 4.9–5.2%, U.S. online sales increased 23% year-over-year, and retail sentiment shifted from neutral to strong.
